fact: The brightest star of the Peacock — an English name born of 20th-century navigation.
bio: Peacock (Alpha Pavonis) is a hot blue system about 180 light-years away, the brightest star in Pavo, the Peacock, deep in the southern sky.
cultural: Like Avior, its name is modern: the British nautical almanac of the 1930s required names for bright southern stars, and 'Peacock' was coined from its constellation. Pavo was one of the southern 'bird' constellations of the exploration era.
